tools.name: plan_get
tools.description: Read the team's shared plan: goals, tasks, contracts (APIs/schemas/types), decisions, open questions, and the last day of notebook entries. Pass kind to see everything of one kind, including finished tasks.

kind.description: Only return this kind of entry

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: task_claim
tools.description: Claim a task so teammates know you are working on it. Call before starting a piece of work. To pick up a task already in the plan, pass just its key.

title.description: Required when the task is not in the plan yet

areas.description: Files, directories or topics this task touches

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: task_add
tools.description: Add tasks to the shared plan without starting them, e.g. when breaking work down for the team. Tasks are unassigned unless you set owner; teammates' agents pick them up with task_claim.

description.description: What done looks like, in a sentence or two

areas.description: Files, directories or topics this task touches

depends_on.description: Keys of tasks that must be done first

owner.description: Member id to assign it to; omit to leave it open for anyone

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Update a task: progress note, status change, or mark done/blocked.

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: contract_publish
tools.description: Publish or change something other agents build against: an API route and its request/response shape, a DB schema, a shared type, an env var, or file ownership. Set breaking=true if existing consumers must change. If it supersedes an existing contract under another key, pass replaces.

spec.description: The concrete shape, e.g. "{ id: uuid, email: string }"

replaces.description: Keys of existing entries this one replaces (they are removed from the plan). Use "kind:key" to replace a different kind.

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: decision_log
tools.description: Record a project decision teammates should follow (library choice, convention, architecture). If it overturns an earlier decision, pass replaces so the old one is removed instead of contradicting it.

replaces.description: Keys of existing entries this one replaces (they are removed from the plan). Use "kind:key" to replace a different kind.

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: goal_set
tools.description: Set or change a project goal. If the plan already has goals, you must say how the new one relates: replaces=[keys] when it supersedes them (they are removed), or alongside=true when it's a competing proposal the team hasn't chosen between yet. If you don't know which, ask the user first.

replaces.description: Keys of existing entries this one replaces (they are removed from the plan). Use "kind:key" to replace a different kind.

alongside.description: Keep existing goals and mark this as a competing proposal

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: question
tools.description: Ask the team an open question, or answer one: providing answer resolves it and removes it from the open questions.

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: note_add
tools.description: Write to the team notebook: status, observations, measurements, results, environment state (e.g. 'lab box is busy until 14:00', 'eval run: precision 0.82', 'image built locally, not in the registry'). Use this instead of decision_log for anything that is a fact about the current state rather than a choice the team must follow. Notes from the last 24h are shown to every agent.

key.description: Reuse a key to update a running note (e.g. "lab-status"); omit for a one-off note

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: notebook_get
tools.description: Read the team notebook (status notes, observations, results), newest first. Optionally only notes matching a search term.

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: plan_remove
tools.description: Remove an obsolete entry from the plan, optionally naming what replaced it.

superseded_by.description: "kind:key" of the entry that replaces it, if any

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: plan_tidy
tools.description: Find plan entries that are finished, duplicated or outdated (tasks the commits show done, superseded images/deployments, contracts that are only internal details, decisions that are really status). Returns proposals; pass apply=true to apply them. Takes ~20s.

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.

tools.name: plan_review
tools.description: Check the shared plan for contradictions (competing goals, decisions that cannot both hold, obsolete tasks). Takes ~15s. Use it when the plan looks inconsistent, then resolve with goal_set/decision_log replaces or plan_remove, asking the user when it is a team choice.

repo.description: Path inside the repo you're working in. Only needed if hivemind says it can't tell which repo you mean.
